spec2def(hlink.dll hlink.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(hlink registry hlink_classes.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# hlink.dll is all Rust (hlink-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hlink-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# browse_ctx.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hlink-rust/src/hlink/browse_ctx.rs)
# extserv.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hlink-rust/src/hlink/extserv.rs)
# hlink_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hlink-rust/src/hlink/hlink_main.rs)
# link.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hlink-rust/src/hlink/link.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(hlink_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(hlink_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames libshell32 libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(hlink_shims)
set(HLINK_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/hlink/hlink_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(hlink hlink-cargo hlink.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE hlink-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hlink_shims hlink_r ${HLINK_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
